script.title: Script language
script.description: The HS language itself: the special forms that sequence and branch scripts, the arithmetic and comparison operators, the sleep family, casts between object types, and printing. Everything else in the table is the engine API these forms call into.

functions.name: begin
functions.description: Evaluates each expression in order and returns the value of the last.

functions.name: begin_random
functions.description: Evaluates the expressions in a random order.

functions.name: cond
functions.description: Evaluates the first result whose condition is true.

functions.name: device
functions.description: Casts an object to a device.

functions.name: if
functions.description: Evaluates the second expression if the condition is true, otherwise the optional third.

functions.name: inspect
functions.description: Prints an expression's value to the console.

functions.name: not
functions.description: Logical negation.

functions.name: print
functions.description: Prints a string to the console.

functions.name: scenery
functions.description: Casts an object to scenery.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Assigns a value to a global variable.

functions.name: sleep
functions.description: Pauses the current script for the given number of simulation ticks.

functions.name: sleep_forever
functions.description: Pauses the current script, or the named one, until something wakes it.

functions.name: sleep_until
functions.description: Pauses the current script until the condition is true, re-testing it every so many ticks.

functions.name: unit
functions.description: Casts an object to a unit.

functions.name: vehicle
functions.description: Casts an object to a vehicle.

functions.name: wake
functions.description: Wakes a sleeping script by name.

functions.name: weapon
functions.description: Casts an object to a weapon.

other.title: Everything else
other.description: Prefixes with too few members for a page of their own.

functions.name: players
functions.description: A list of every player's unit.

debug.title: Debugging
debug.description: Debugging aids. Most of these are compiled out of the release build and answer without doing anything.

player.title: Players
player.description: The local players: their units, effects, input, training text and the flags that gate campaign progress.

volume.title: Volumes
volume.description: Trigger volumes: testing objects and players against them, and teleporting the ones outside.

functions.name: volume_teleport_players_not_inside
functions.description: Teleports any player outside the trigger volume to the flag.

functions.name: volume_test_object
functions.description: Whether an object is inside a trigger volume.

functions.name: volume_test_objects
functions.description: Whether any object in the list is inside a trigger volume.

functions.name: volume_test_objects_all
functions.description: Whether every object in the list is inside a trigger volume.

object.title: Objects
object.description: Scenario objects in general: creation and destruction by name, teleporting, scaling, damage and the object lists the scripts iterate.

functions.name: object_create
functions.description: Creates the named scenario object if it does not already exist.

functions.name: object_create_anew
functions.description: Creates the named scenario object, replacing any existing one.

functions.name: object_destroy
functions.description: Destroys the named scenario object.

functions.name: object_hide
functions.description: Hides or shows an object without destroying it.

functions.name: object_set_scale
functions.description: Scales an object to the given size over the given number of ticks.

functions.name: object_teleport
functions.description: Moves an object to a cutscene flag.

functions.name: objects_attach
functions.description: Attaches one object to another at the named markers.

functions.name: objects_detach
functions.description: Detaches an object attached with objects_attach.

console.title: Console
console.description: Commands that belong to the console itself rather than the engine. The MJOLNIR mod answers `help` on its own, from this same table.

functions.name: cls
functions.description: Clears the console.

functions.name: help
functions.description: Lists functions and globals whose names contain the given text, with signatures.

game.title: Game state
game.description: The game session: saving and reverting checkpoints, difficulty, co-op state, winning and losing, and the tick counters.

functions.name: game_difficulty_get
functions.description: The difficulty the game was started on.

functions.name: game_is_cooperative
functions.description: Whether more than one player is in the game.

functions.name: game_lost
functions.description: Ends the level as a loss.

functions.name: game_rate
functions.description: Sets the simulation rate: 1 is normal, 0.5 is half speed. The second and third arguments are ramp and duration in seconds as far as testing shows; `game_rate 0.5 0 30` put the game in slow motion, and `game_rate 1 0 0` restores it. This is the live replacement for the game_speed global, which has no storage in this build.

functions.name: game_revert
functions.description: Reverts to the last checkpoint.

functions.name: game_save
functions.description: Requests a checkpoint at the next safe moment.

functions.name: game_save_no_timeout
functions.description: Requests a checkpoint and waits as long as it takes for a safe moment.

functions.name: game_tick_get
functions.description: The simulation tick counter. It advances about sixty times a second and keeps advancing at that rate under game_rate, so it measures real time, not game time.

functions.name: game_won
functions.description: Ends the level as a win.

render.title: Rendering
render.description: Rendering switches: clip distances, lighting and effect toggles, most compiled out of the release build.

unit.title: Units
unit.description: Bipeds and vehicles as units: health, shields, seats, weapons, emotions and the animations a scripted unit plays.

functions.name: unit_enter_vehicle
functions.description: Puts a unit into the named seat of a vehicle.

functions.name: unit_exit_vehicle
functions.description: Makes a unit leave its vehicle.

functions.name: unit_get_health
functions.description: A unit's health as a fraction from 0 to 1.

functions.name: unit_get_shield
functions.description: A unit's shield as a fraction from 0 to 1.

functions.name: unit_kill
functions.description: Kills a unit.

vehicle.title: Vehicles
vehicle.description: Vehicles as containers: loading and unloading seats, hovering and the vehicle-specific state.

functions.name: vehicle_load_magic
functions.description: Loads the given units into a vehicle's seats without animation.

functions.name: vehicle_unload
functions.description: Unloads the named seat of a vehicle.

device.title: Devices
device.description: Devices: doors, lifts, switches and machines, driven by position and power from 0 to 1.

functions.name: device_get_position
functions.description: A device's position from 0 (closed) to 1 (open).

functions.name: device_get_power
functions.description: A device's power from 0 to 1.

functions.name: device_set_position
functions.description: Moves a device to a position from 0 (closed) to 1 (open).

functions.name: device_set_power
functions.description: Sets a device's power from 0 to 1; an unpowered device does not move.

cheat.title: Cheats
cheat.description: The classic cheats. Every one of them is compiled out of this build: the engine accepts the name and does nothing.

functions.name: cheat_active_camouflage
functions.description: Gives the player active camouflage.

functions.name: cheat_all_vehicles
functions.description: Spawns one of every vehicle near the player.

functions.name: cheat_all_weapons
functions.description: Gives the player every weapon.

functions.name: cheat_teleport_to_camera
functions.description: Teleports the player to the camera's position.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Placing, commanding and querying AI: squads, encounters, orders, awareness, vehicles and the actor state the campaign scripts drive.

functions.name: ai_enable
functions.description: Turns AI updating on or off.

functions.name: ai_enabled
functions.description: Whether AI updating is on.

functions.name: ai_erase
functions.description: Removes the named AI from the game without death effects.

functions.name: ai_erase_all
functions.description: Removes every AI from the game.

functions.name: ai_kill
functions.description: Kills the named AI immediately, with death effects.

functions.name: ai_living_count
functions.description: The number of living actors in the named squad or encounter.

functions.name: ai_magically_see
functions.description: Makes the AI aware of the given unit as if it had seen it.

functions.name: ai_place
functions.description: Places the named squad or encounter, optionally with a given number of actors.

flock.title: Flocks
flock.description: Flocks: the ambient creatures spawned in groups.

cs.title: Command scripts
cs.description: Command scripts: the per-actor movement and behaviour sequences that scripted set pieces are built from. Most take the script's own actor as an implicit subject.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Scripted cameras: taking control from the player, moving between points and the camera modes.

functions.name: camera_control
functions.description: Takes control of the camera for scripts (true) or gives it back to the player (false).

functions.name: camera_set
functions.description: Moves the camera to a cutscene camera point over the given number of ticks.

cinematic.title: Cinematics
cinematic.description: Cinematic mode, letterboxing, scripted cameras and the title cards and screen effects that cutscenes use.

functions.name: cinematic_start
functions.description: Enters cinematic mode: hides the HUD and hands the camera to the script.

functions.name: cinematic_stop
functions.description: Leaves cinematic mode.

functions.name: fade_in
functions.description: Fades the screen in from the given colour over the given number of ticks.

functions.name: fade_out
functions.description: Fades the screen out to the given colour over the given number of ticks.

survival.title: Firefight
survival.description: Firefight: waves, rounds, sets, bonus rounds and the scoring that goes with them.

chud.title: HUD
chud.description: The in-game HUD: showing and hiding its parts, objectives and chapter titles on screen, and training prompts.

functions.name: chud_show
functions.description: Shows or hides the whole HUD.

functions.name: chud_show_crosshair
functions.description: Shows or hides the crosshair.

functions.name: chud_show_motion_sensor
functions.description: Shows or hides the motion sensor.

functions.name: chud_show_screen_chapter_title
functions.description: Puts a chapter title on screen.

functions.name: chud_show_screen_objective
functions.description: Puts an objective string on screen.

functions.name: chud_show_shield
functions.description: Shows or hides the shield bar.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Playing and stopping sound tags, looping sounds, music and the mixer classes.

functions.name: sound_impulse_start
functions.description: Plays a sound tag at an object, at the given volume.

functions.name: sound_impulse_stop
functions.description: Stops a sound started with sound_impulse_start.

functions.name: sound_looping_start
functions.description: Starts a looping sound at an object, at the given volume.

functions.name: sound_looping_stop
functions.description: Stops a looping sound.

events.title: Events
events.description: The engine's event log and its display, largely compiled out of the release build.

controller.title: Controllers
controller.description: Controller profiles and settings as the scripts read them.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.description: Mission objectives as shown on the HUD: showing, finishing and clearing them by index.

net.title: Networking
net.description: Networking: the session, hosting, and the counters a network game exposes to scripts.

mp.title: Multiplayer
mp.description: Multiplayer game state exposed to scripts.

tag.title: Tags
tag.description: Tag loading and reloading at runtime.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.description: The deterministic simulation: its tick, its state and its debugging counters.

skull.title: Skulls
skull.description: Skulls, switched from the console with skull_enable and read back with skull_enabled. All four functions are live, and this is the shipped route to most of what the compiled-out cheats did: skull_bandanna is bottomless ammo and grenades, and the counter turns to the infinity sign the moment it is enabled. The skull argument must be one of these names (the compiler lists them when given anything else; the list it prints is cut off after skull_leadhead, so there may be a few more): skull_iron, skull_black_eye, skull_tough_luck, skull_catch, skull_fog, skull_famine, skull_thunderstorm, skull_tilt, skull_mythic, skull_assassin, skull_blind, skull_superman, skull_birthday_party, skull_daddy, skull_red, skull_yellow, skull_blue, skull_angry, skull_bandanna, skull_bonded_pair, skull_boom, skull_envy, skull_eye_patch, skull_foreign, skull_ghost, skull_grunt_funeral, skull_jacked, skull_malfunction, skull_masterblaster, skull_pinata, skull_recession, skull_scarab, skull_so_angry, skull_swarm, skull_thats_just_wrong, skull_they_come_back, skull_boots_off_the_ground, skull_adaptation, skull_reload, skull_spore_visibility, skull_night_vision, skull_lights_out, skull_riskrun, skull_pop, skull_armistice, skull_fragile, skull_give_and_take, skull_stow_and_grow, skull_hip_fire, skull_temperamental, skull_floor_is_lava, skull_magnified, skull_johnny_ammo_tree, skull_leadhead.

functions.name: skull_affects_players
functions.description: Whether the named skull applies to players, or only to AI.

functions.name: skull_any_enabled
functions.description: Whether any skull is on.

functions.name: skull_enable
functions.description: Turns a skull on or off. Verified live: `skull_enable skull_bandanna true` gave bottomless ammo at once. Takes a skull name from the list on this page, not a bare word.

functions.name: skull_enabled
functions.description: Whether the named skull is on.

cui.title: UI screens
cui.description: The UI screen stack: opening, closing and querying screens by name.

meteorite.title: Meteorite additions
meteorite.description: Functions 343 added for Halo Campaign Evolved, recognisable by their capitalised names. None appear in the classic engines.

globals.name: cheat_chevy
globals.description: Vehicles run like they used to.

globals.name: cheat_infinite_ammo
globals.description: Weapons never run out of ammunition.

globals.name: cheat_jetpack
globals.description: Holding jump keeps the player airborne.

globals.name: cheat_medusa
globals.description: AI dies as soon as it sees the player.

globals.name: cheat_omnipotent
globals.description: Every shot the player fires kills.
